name: Straw Hat Crew
blurb: Luffy and the Straw Hat Crew charge in fast. Once a turn Luffy hands an extra DON!! card to a crewmate so its attack hits harder.

name: Worst Generation
blurb: The Worst Generation captains team up. Kid can stand back up after attacking, so he gets to swing again.

name: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
blurb: The Seven Warlords play tricks: Crocodile sends an enemy Character back to its owner’s hand, and lots of cards fight back when your Life is hit.

name: Animal Kingdom Pirates
blurb: Kaido’s Animal Kingdom Pirates are big and scary. Save up DON!! cards, then Kaido smashes one of your opponent’s Life cards away.

name: ONE PIECE FILM edition
blurb: Heroes and villains from the ONE PIECE movies. Shanks gives every FILM Character +2000 power for one big attack turn.

name: Absolute Justice
blurb: The Navy shrinks enemy Characters’ costs until they hit 0, then Admiral Sakazuki knocks them out.

name: Big Mom Pirates
blurb: Big Mom’s family plays with Life cards. Linlin can grab a Life card when she attacks and put a better card back when you’re in danger.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
blurb: Luffy and his friends from the early adventures. Every time a Character is knocked out on your turn, Luffy gets an extra DON!! card.

name: Yamato
blurb: Yamato and the samurai of Wano. When your Life runs low, Yamato gets tougher to beat.

name: Ultra Deck: The Three Captains
blurb: Three captains fight side by side, and any of them can lead: Luffy gets a free DON!! card when you have none or lots, Law swaps a small enemy Character for one from your hand, and Kid hits harder as his Life runs low.

name: Uta
blurb: Uta the singer and the Straw Hats. When Uta attacks she can pull a FILM card from the top of your deck into your hand.

name: Zoro & Sanji
blurb: Zoro and Sanji share one Leader card. When they attack, they can send a friend back to your hand to stand up another Character so it can attack again.

name: Ultra Deck: The Three Brothers
blurb: Ace, Sabo and Luffy, the three brothers, and any of them can lead: Luffy puts big Characters back on his empty Life, Sabo turns a Character into face-up Life to power up another, and Ace digs cost-5 Characters into his Life.

name: 3D2Y
blurb: The Straw Hats two years later. Luffy makes all your Characters cost a bit more, which switches on lots of their powers.

name: RED Edward.Newgate
blurb: Whitebeard starts with 6 Life and 6000 power. At the end of each of your turns he takes a Life card into your hand, so you always have cards to play.

name: GREEN Uta
blurb: Uta sings with lots of Event cards. When she attacks she can pull a FILM card from the top of your deck into your hand.

name: BLUE Donquixote Doflamingo
blurb: Doflamingo pulls strings: when he attacks he can flip the top card of your deck and play a Warlord for free.

name: PURPLE Monkey.D.Luffy
blurb: Purple Luffy plays with DON!! cards. He can trade a Life card for an extra DON!! card to pay for big Characters sooner.

name: BLACK Smoker
blurb: Smoker’s Navy lowers enemy costs. When an enemy Character reaches cost 0, Smoker gets stronger and your cards can knock it out.

name: YELLOW Charlotte Katakuri
blurb: Katakuri can see the future: when he attacks he peeks at a Life card, puts it on the top or bottom, and gets +1000 power.

name: EX Gear 5
blurb: Gear 5 Luffy gives two DON!! cards at once to a Straw Hat friend, so it can hit really hard.

name: RED Shanks
blurb: Shanks and the Red-Haired Pirates. When your opponent attacks, Shanks takes 1000 power away from one of their cards.

name: GREEN Jewelry Bonney
blurb: Bonney and the Worst Generation. When your opponent attacks, Bonney can rest one of their cards so it can’t fight back.

name: BLUE Buggy
blurb: Buggy’s Cross Guild. Rest five DON!! cards and throw away a card to play a Cross Guild Character for free.

name: PURPLE/BLACK Monkey.D.Luffy
blurb: Luffy and the Straw Hats in purple and black. Luffy makes your Characters cost more and gets DON!! cards back when you spend them.

name: BLACK Marshall.D.Teach
blurb: Blackbeard turns off [On Play] powers: his own, and if you throw away a card, your opponent’s too.

name: GREEN/YELLOW Yamato
blurb: Yamato hits twice: every attack from your Leader takes 2 Life cards. When your opponent is low on Life, she gives two DON!! cards to a friend.

name: Ace & Newgate
blurb: Ace and Whitebeard share one Leader card. Show a Whitebeard Pirates card from your hand to draw a card and stack the top of your deck.

name: Egghead
blurb: The Straw Hats on Egghead island. Luffy starts with 6 Life, and once your Life gets low he swaps a card in your hand for a new one every time he attacks.

name: EX Luffy & Ace
blurb: Luffy and Ace share one Leader card. On your opponent’s turn every Luffy and Ace gets +3000 power, so they’re hard to beat.

name: RED Monkey.D.Luffy
blurb: Red Luffy gives two DON!! cards at once to a Straw Hat friend, so it can hit really hard.

name: GREEN Roronoa Zoro
blurb: Zoro and the swordfighters of Wano. After Zoro battles a Character he can stand back up and attack again.

name: BLUE Kuzan
blurb: Admiral Kuzan and the Navy. Every time a Navy card makes you throw away a card, you draw a new one.

name: PURPLE Charlotte Katakuri
blurb: Katakuri and Big Mom’s family. Katakuri peeks at the top of your opponent’s deck and gets +1000 power in battle.

name: RED/BLACK Sabo
blurb: Sabo and the Revolutionary Army. Once you have a Character that costs 8 or more, your Leader and all your Characters get +1000 power.

name: YELLOW Eustass"Captain"Kid
blurb: Kid and the Worst Generation. At the end of your turn Kid can stand a friend back up and make it a Blocker to guard you.
